past_paper_mcqs.stem_text: If a planet comes closer to the Sun, then the planet will
options: D. keep moving with the same speed.
past_paper_mcqs.explanation: According to Kepler's Second Law of Planetary Motion (Law of Areas) and conservation of angular momentum, as a planet gets closer to the Sun (perihelion), its orbital speed increases.

past_paper_mcqs.stem_text: The gravitational force between two objects is directly proportional to the
options: D. square of the distance between them.
past_paper_mcqs.explanation: According to Newton's Law of Gravitation, the gravitational force $F$ between two point masses $m_1$ and $m_2$ separated by a distance $r$ is given by $F = G \frac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}$. Thus, the force is directly proportional to the product of their masses.

past_paper_mcqs.stem_text: A car travels a distance of 150 m in the direction of a constant force of 50 N. The work done on the car is
past_paper_mcqs.explanation: Work done ($W$) is given by the formula $W = F \times d$. Here, Force $F = 50\text{ N}$ and distance $d = 150\text{ m}$. $W = 50\text{ N} \times 150\text{ m} = 7500\text{ J}$.

past_paper_mcqs.stem_text: A car has stopped after screeching to avoid a crash with a van. With reference to the given situation, the kinetic energy of the car will then be converted into
past_paper_mcqs.explanation: When a car screeches to a stop, friction between the tires and the road generates thermal energy (heat) and the screeching noise produces sound energy.
